name: Amazon EC2
description: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) provides resizable virtual servers in the cloud. You choose from hundreds of instance types with different combinations of CPU, memory, storage, networking, and GPUs, and pay only for the capacity you use.

name: AWS Lambda
description: AWS Lambda runs your code without provisioning or managing servers. Functions run in response to events such as HTTP requests, file uploads, or queue messages, scale automatically, and you pay only for the compute time you use.

name: Amazon ECS
description: Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) is a fully managed container orchestration service for deploying, managing, and scaling containerized applications, on EC2 instances or serverless with AWS Fargate.

name: Amazon EKS
description: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) is a managed Kubernetes service that runs the Kubernetes control plane for you, so you can run Kubernetes workloads on AWS and on premises without operating the cluster infrastructure.

name: AWS Fargate
description: AWS Fargate is a serverless compute engine for containers. It works with Amazon ECS and Amazon EKS and removes the need to provision and manage servers or clusters of virtual machines.

name: Amazon Lightsail
description: Amazon Lightsail offers easy-to-use virtual private servers, containers, databases, and storage for a low, predictable monthly price. It's designed for simple websites, web applications, and small business workloads.

name: Amazon S3
description: Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) is object storage built to store and retrieve any amount of data from anywhere, with industry-leading durability, availability, and security. It's used for data lakes, websites, backups, and archives.

name: Amazon EBS
description: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) provides high-performance block storage volumes for Amazon EC2 instances, for databases, file systems, and applications that need low-latency storage.

name: Amazon EFS
description: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) is a serverless, elastic shared file system that many compute instances and containers can mount at the same time, and that grows and shrinks automatically as you add and remove files.

name: Amazon RDS
description: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) is a managed relational database service for MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Oracle, SQL Server, and Db2. It handles provisioning, patching, backups, and high availability.

name: Amazon Aurora
description: Amazon Aurora is a MySQL- and PostgreSQL-compatible relational database built for the cloud, with high performance and availability at global scale. Aurora Serverless scales capacity automatically with demand.

name: Amazon DynamoDB
description: Amazon DynamoDB is a serverless, fully managed NoSQL key-value and document database that delivers single-digit millisecond performance at any scale, with built-in security, backups, and global replication for massive amounts of data.

name: Amazon DocumentDB
description: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) is a fully managed, scalable JSON document database for storing, querying, and indexing JSON data, compatible with MongoDB drivers and tools.

name: Amazon Keyspaces
description: Amazon Keyspaces (for Apache Cassandra) is a serverless, Apache Cassandra-compatible NoSQL database service for running Cassandra workloads at scale without managing servers.

name: Amazon Neptune
description: Amazon Neptune is a managed graph database service for building applications that work with highly connected data, such as social networks, recommendation engines, fraud detection, and knowledge graphs.

name: Amazon ElastiCache
description: Amazon ElastiCache is a fully managed in-memory caching service compatible with Valkey, Redis OSS, and Memcached, used to speed up applications with microsecond latency for caching, session stores, and leaderboards.

name: Amazon Redshift
description: Amazon Redshift is a fully managed, petabyte-scale cloud data warehouse for running analytics queries with SQL across your data warehouse, operational databases, and data lake.

name: Amazon Athena
description: Amazon Athena is a serverless, interactive query service that analyzes data directly in Amazon S3 using standard SQL. There's no infrastructure to manage, and you pay only for the queries you run.

name: AWS Glue
description: AWS Glue is a serverless data integration service that discovers, prepares, moves, and integrates data from many sources for analytics, machine learning, and application development, including a central data catalog.

name: Amazon Kinesis
description: Amazon Kinesis collects, processes, and analyzes real-time streaming data such as application logs, clickstreams, and IoT telemetry, so you can react to new information within seconds.

name: Amazon QuickSight
description: Amazon QuickSight is a cloud-native business intelligence service for building interactive dashboards, reports, and natural language queries over your data, available to users across your organization.

name: Amazon OpenSearch Service
description: Amazon OpenSearch Service makes it easy to run OpenSearch for log analytics, real-time application monitoring, full-text search, and vector search. OpenSearch Serverless removes the need to manage clusters.

name: Amazon Bedrock
description: Amazon Bedrock is a fully managed service for building generative AI applications with a choice of foundation models from leading AI companies through a single API, with guardrails, knowledge bases, and agents.

name: Amazon SageMaker AI
description: Amazon SageMaker AI is a fully managed service to build, train, and deploy machine learning models at scale, with managed notebooks, training jobs, model hosting, and MLOps tools.

name: Amazon Rekognition
description: Amazon Rekognition adds image and video analysis to applications: object and scene detection, face comparison, text in images, content moderation, and custom labels, without machine learning expertise.

name: Amazon Textract
description: Amazon Textract automatically extracts printed text, handwriting, tables, forms, and other data from scanned documents and images, going beyond simple optical character recognition.

name: Amazon Transcribe
description: Amazon Transcribe converts speech to text automatically, for call center analytics, subtitles, meeting notes, and medical dictation, with support for many languages.

name: Amazon Polly
description: Amazon Polly turns text into lifelike speech in dozens of languages and voices, so you can build applications that talk, such as voice assistants, e-learning, and accessibility features.

name: Amazon Translate
description: Amazon Translate is a neural machine translation service that delivers fast, high-quality, and affordable translation of text and documents between many languages.

name: Amazon Comprehend
description: Amazon Comprehend uses natural language processing to find insights in text, such as entities, key phrases, language, sentiment, and personally identifiable information.

name: Amazon Lex
description: Amazon Lex is a service for building conversational interfaces using voice and text, such as chatbots and contact center virtual agents, with automatic speech recognition and language understanding.

name: Amazon Connect
description: Amazon Connect is a cloud contact center that lets businesses deliver customer service over voice, chat, and tasks, with AI features for self-service, agent assistance, and analytics.

name: Amazon WorkSpaces
description: Amazon WorkSpaces is a fully managed virtual desktop service. Users access their Windows or Linux desktop and applications from any supported device, and IT doesn't need to manage desktop hardware.

name: Amazon AppStream 2.0
description: Amazon AppStream 2.0 is a fully managed application streaming service that gives users instant access to desktop applications from a web browser, without rewriting the applications.

name: Amazon Chime SDK
description: The Amazon Chime SDK lets developers add real-time audio, video, screen sharing, and messaging to their own web and mobile applications.

name: Amazon CloudFront
description: Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network that delivers websites, videos, APIs, and other content to users worldwide with low latency, high transfer speeds, and built-in security.

name: Amazon Route 53
description: Amazon Route 53 is a highly available and scalable Domain Name System (DNS) web service for domain registration, DNS routing, and health checking.

name: Amazon VPC
description: Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC) lets you launch AWS resources in a logically isolated virtual network that you define, with control over IP ranges, subnets, route tables, and network gateways.

name: Elastic Load Balancing
description: Elastic Load Balancing automatically distributes incoming application traffic across multiple targets, such as EC2 instances, containers, and IP addresses, in one or more Availability Zones.

name: Amazon API Gateway
description: Amazon API Gateway is a fully managed service for creating, publishing, securing, and monitoring REST, HTTP, and WebSocket APIs at any scale.

name: Amazon SQS
description: Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) is a fully managed message queuing service for decoupling and scaling microservices, distributed systems, and serverless applications.

name: Amazon SNS
description: Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) is a fully managed publish/subscribe messaging service for application-to-application and application-to-person notifications, including SMS, email, and mobile push.

name: Amazon EventBridge
description: Amazon EventBridge is a serverless event bus that connects applications using events from your own applications, AWS services, and SaaS applications, with rules, scheduling, and pipes.

name: AWS Step Functions
description: AWS Step Functions is a visual workflow service for orchestrating AWS services, automating business processes, and building serverless applications, with built-in error handling and retries.

name: AWS IAM
description: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) lets you securely control who can access which AWS services and resources, with fine-grained permissions, roles, and temporary credentials.

name: Amazon Cognito
description: Amazon Cognito adds user sign-up, sign-in, and access control to web and mobile apps, and supports social and enterprise identity providers. It scales to millions of users.

name: AWS KMS
description: AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) lets you create and control the cryptographic keys used to encrypt your data across AWS services and your own applications.

name: AWS Secrets Manager
description: AWS Secrets Manager helps you store, rotate, and retrieve database credentials, API keys, and other secrets throughout their lifecycle, so you don't hard-code them in applications.

name: AWS WAF
description: AWS WAF is a web application firewall that protects web applications and APIs against common exploits and bots that can affect availability, compromise security, or consume excessive resources.

name: Amazon GuardDuty
description: Amazon GuardDuty is a threat detection service that continuously monitors your AWS accounts and workloads for malicious activity and delivers detailed security findings.

name: Amazon CloudWatch
description: Amazon CloudWatch collects and visualizes metrics, logs, and traces from your applications and AWS resources, with alarms, dashboards, and automated actions.

name: AWS CloudTrail
description: AWS CloudTrail records user activity and API calls across your AWS accounts for auditing, security analysis, and compliance.

name: AWS CloudFormation
description: AWS CloudFormation lets you model, provision, and manage AWS and third-party resources by treating infrastructure as code, using templates in JSON or YAML.

name: AWS Amplify
description: AWS Amplify is a set of tools and services for front-end web and mobile developers to build, deploy, and host full-stack applications on AWS quickly.

name: AWS IoT Core
description: AWS IoT Core lets you connect billions of IoT devices and route trillions of messages to AWS services securely, without managing infrastructure.

name: AWS Backup
description: AWS Backup is a fully managed service to centralize and automate data protection across AWS services and hybrid workloads, with backup policies and monitoring.

name: Amazon GameLift
description: Amazon GameLift deploys, operates, and scales dedicated game servers for multiplayer games in the cloud, with low latency for players around the world.
